attempted_claim: Let M0 be the least-volume closed genus-2 surface bundle tabulated in the Aaber-Dunfield family of Whitehead-sibling fillings (arXiv:1002.3423, explicit filling slopes in Table 1), with rigorous hyperbolic volume V0 to be certified in-hour by interval-verified triangulation; V0 lies strictly below the cusped parent volume near 3.66. Let C3 be the set of closed orientable hyperbolic 3-manifolds M fibering over the circle with closed genus-2 fiber and pseudo-Anosov monodromy of dilatation lambda satisfying 1.72208 <= lambda <= 1.90, with fiberedness by Stallings/Thurston-norm data, dilatation by transition-matrix characteristic polynomial, and hyperbolicity by rigorous triangulation certificate. Is M0 the unique minimal-volume member of C3, i.e. does every M in C3 satisfy vol(M) >= V0 with equality only for M homeomorphic to M0? A complete answer either proves the minimality of V0 over C3 via Neumann-Zagier volume comparison plus low-volume (Gabai-Meyerhoff-Milley) census elimination, or exhibits one explicit M in C3 with fibration, dilatation, and hyperbolicity certificates and rigorously certified volume strictly below V0.
decisive_failure: The non-existence argument for the presupposed hyperbolic M0 rests on the published Aaber-Dunfield genus formula plus floating-point SnapPy degeneracy evidence rather than an interval-verified hyperbolicity obstruction, since Sage, Regina, and hikmot-style certification were unavailable. No claim is made about minimal volumes over the dilatation-restricted class C3, and no emergent finding is submitted.
